map.隧道衬砌厚度计算 使用指南: Tunnel Lining Thickness Calculation User Guide
map.输入围岩级别与开挖跨度，按经验系数（k=0.04~0.10）估算初期支护与二次衬: Enter surrounding rock grade and excavation span and estimate primary support and secondary lining thickness by empirical coefficient (k = 0.04 to 0.10), supporting tunnel lining structural design and safety margin checks.
map.二衬厚度：按围岩级别取二次衬砌系数 k（Ⅰ级 0.04、Ⅱ级 0.05、Ⅲ级 0: Secondary lining thickness: take the secondary lining coefficient k by surrounding rock grade (grade I 0.04, II 0.05, III 0.06, IV 0.075, V 0.09, VI 0.10), h2 = k × excavation span B, rounded up to 0.1 m and not less than 0.3 m; the worse the rock the larger k and the thicker the secondary lining.
map.初衬喷层：初期支护喷射混凝土厚度按围岩级别取定值（Ⅰ级 5 cm、Ⅱ级 8、Ⅲ级: Primary lining shotcrete: initial support shotcrete thickness is a set value by surrounding rock grade (grade I 5 cm, II 8, III 12, IV 15, V 20, VI 25 cm), and total support thickness = primary lining thickness + secondary lining thickness.
map.配筋与工程量：Ⅳ级及以上（grade≥5）判为需配筋（钢筋混凝土），Ⅰ~Ⅲ级为素: Reinforcement and quantities: grade IV and above (grade at least 5) is judged as needing reinforcement (reinforced concrete), grades I–III as plain concrete; and secondary lining thickness estimates concrete per linear meter ≈ h2 × 2 × (B + 5) m³ (perimeter approximation), for material planning and cost estimation.
map.算例：开挖跨度 10 m 时六个围岩级别的衬砌厚度: Worked example: lining thickness for six surrounding rock grades at an excavation span of 10 m
map.：取 B=10 m：Ⅰ级 k=0.04 → h₂=0.4 m（40 cm），初衬: : take B = 10 m: grade I k = 0.04 -> h2 = 0.4 m (40 cm), primary lining 5 cm, total 45 cm, plain concrete, secondary lining about 12.0 m³ per linear meter; grade II k = 0.05 -> h2 = 0.5 m, primary lining 8 cm, total 58 cm, about 15.0 m³; grade III k = 0.06 -> h2 = 0.6 m, primary lining 12 cm, total 72 cm, about 18.0 m³; grade IV k = 0.075 -> h2 = 0.8 m, primary lining 15 cm, total 95 cm, reinforcement required, about 24.0 m³; grade V k = 0.09 -> h2 = 0.9 m, primary lining 20 cm, total 110 cm, reinforcement required, about 27.0 m³; grade VI k = 0.10 -> h2 = 1.0 m, primary lining 25 cm, total 125 cm, reinforcement required, about 30.0 m³. As span grows the secondary lining thickens linearly: grade IV, B = 14 m -> h2 = k × 14 = 1.05 m rounded to 1.1 m (110 cm), total 125 cm, about 41.8 m³ per linear meter.
map.二次衬砌厚度为什么按 k×跨度 估算，而不是按荷载计算？: Why estimate secondary lining thickness as k × span instead of calculating from loads?
map.k×B 是工程类比法的经验取值，把围岩级别（完整性、强度、地下水等综合分级）与开: k × B is an empirical value from the engineering analogy method, compressing the two main factors - surrounding rock grade (a composite rating of integrity, strength, groundwater and so on) and excavation span - into one coefficient, for fast thickness estimation and material planning at the scheme stage. Formal design should model by the load-structure or ground-structure method, including surrounding rock pressure, water pressure, seismic force and self weight, and check reinforcement of the secondary lining; this tool's result cannot replace a structural calculation report.
map.Ⅳ级以上必须配筋的依据是什么，素混凝土二衬用在什么情况？: What is the basis for requiring reinforcement at grade IV and above, and when is plain concrete secondary lining used?
map.工具按 grade≥5（Ⅳ级及以上）判为需配筋。原因是围岩较差时二衬要承担显著的: The tool judges reinforcement needed when grade is at least 5 (grade IV and above). The reason is that with poor surrounding rock the secondary lining must carry significant rock pressure and uneven settlement, while plain concrete has low tensile strength and cracks easily. Grades I–III have strong self-supporting capacity, so the secondary lining mostly serves as safety reserve and crack-limiting construction and can be plain concrete; but with bias, shallow cover, portal sections or groundwater attack, reinforcement or steel fiber concrete is needed even in better rock.
